newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close higher in all months.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures closed higher on Monday, as the yen's fall and price gains in CBOT overnight corn trading encouraged local investors to buy, traders said.
Prices were 10 to 160 yen higher, with the benchmark March 1998 contract up 120 yen at 16,050 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 52,013 lots.

All contracts fell at the opening, reflecting price losses on the Chicago corn market on Friday, traders said. "Active buying emerged from individual investors by early afternoon," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot May contract on CBOT Project A was trading at $2.96 per bushel at 0735 GMT, against $2.94-1/4 at Friday's close.
Spot May CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system were at $8.39 per bushel, against $8.41 at Friday's close.
